Message:
fix(security): preserve download failure classification when sanitizing errors

Sanitizing httpx download errors dropped the type and status that
classify_failure uses, so 404/429/503 and transport timeouts all reached
delivery metrics and retained DLQ entries as failure_class="internal".

DownloadFileStepException now carries http_status_code and
is_transport_failure, and classify_failure reads them via a shared
classify_http_status helper, keeping the classification policy in one place
without restoring sensitive exception text.

The sanitized error is also raised after the handler exits: raising inside
it left __context__ pointing at the original httpx error, whose message
contains the presigned URL, reachable from the propagated traceback.

Adds 8 regression cases (4 HTTP statuses, 3 transport errors, context leak),
all reproduced against the previous head before the fix.
